  • Edinburgh Fringe: The 1947 Theatre Revolt That Built the World's Biggest Arts FestivalEight theatre companies weren't invited to Edinburgh's first international festival, so they showed up anyway and performed wherever they could find a room — a gatecrash that, uniquely, was never shut down and never stopped growing.
